 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    DATE(mu.creation) AS usage_date,
    mu.name AS manpower_usage,
    SUM(COALESCE(mud.total_presenty, 0)) AS total_presenty
FROM `tabManpower Usage` mu
INNER JOIN `tabManpower Usage Details` mud
    ON mu.name = mud.parent
WHERE
    mu.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY
    DATE(mu.creation),
    mu.name
ORDER BY
    usage_date,
    mu.name;",
  "type": "sql"
 }
]

operations:
[
 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    si.posting_date AS "Posting Date",
    p.project_name AS "Project",
    SUM(si.grand_total) AS "Invoiced",
    COALESCE(SUM(per.allocated_amount), 0) AS "Collected"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN `tabProject` p
    ON p.name = si.project
LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry Reference` per
    ON per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice'
    AND per.reference_name = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPayment Entry` pe
    ON pe.name = per.parent
    AND pe.docstatus = 1
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY
    si.posting_date,
    p.project_name
ORDER BY
    si.posting_date DESC,
    p.project_name;",
  "type": "sql"
 }
]
title: Project-wise Invoiced and Collected Amounts

name: q7ebq8t9fr
operations:
[
 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    COALESCE(p.custom_site, '') AS site_name,
    p.project_name AS project_name,

    CASE
        WHEN p.custom_site IS NULL OR p.custom_site = ''
        THEN 0
        ELSE COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.custom_site)
    END AS total_projects,

    CASE
        WHEN p.custom_site IS NULL OR p.custom_site = ''
        THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(
            CASE WHEN p.status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY p.custom_site)
    END AS total_open_projects,

    CASE
        WHEN p.custom_site IS NULL OR p.custom_site = ''
        THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(
            CASE WHEN p.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY p.custom_site)
    END AS total_completed_projects,

    COALESCE(p.total_expense_claim, 0) AS total_expense_claim,
    COALESCE(p.total_purchase_cost, 0) AS purchase_cost,
    COALESCE(p.total_consumed_material_cost, 0) AS consumed_material_cost,
    COALESCE(p.total_billed_amount, 0) AS total_billed_amount

FROM `tabProject` p

ORDER BY
    p.custom_site,
    p.project_name;",
  "type": "sql"
 }
]
title: Site And Project Data for number Card
